description: This file contains various functions for retrieving and manipulating MAC addresses and device information on OpenWrt-based systems. It includes methods for extracting MAC addresses from device tree, JSON configuration, MTD partitions, MMC devices, and encrypted storage, as well as functions for MAC address normalization and bit manipulation.

methods.name: get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads a MAC address binary data from a given MTD partition at a specific offset.

methods.name: get_mac_label_dt
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from device tree.

methods.name: get_mac_label_json
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from /etc/board.json configuration.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address by attempting device tree first, then JSON.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds the character device node for a given MTD partition.

methods.name: get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts a MAC address string from a binary partition and canonicalizes it.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Gets a MAC in ASCII format from an MTD partition and key.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts the MAC address from a specific encrypted MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts encrypted MAC address stored in a partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Reads MAC address from UCI configuration stored in UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Reads MAC address embedded as text at a specific offset in an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads MAC address binary data from an MTD partition at a specific offset.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Reads MAC binary data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_part_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a specified MTD partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Gets a MAC in ASCII format from an MMC partition and key.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from an MMC partition.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to a MAC address, adjusting the NIC part.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the SD card's CID hash.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats a MAC address as EUI-64.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Clears a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the local administration bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the multicast bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Normalizes a MAC address to standard format.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled.

methods.name: get_linux_version
methods.description: Returns the current Linux kernel version formatted for comparison.
